total_cost_scope: Recorded CLI turns and ToFa responses from these measured arms. Observed input-only setup-token sensitivity is separate; failed preparations without inference and the supervising conversation are not silently folded into these token totals.
limitations: Published token tariffs and standard API-equivalent context bounds, not measured customer invoices or provider-returned billed service tiers.
Codex used ChatGPT login. Lower API-equivalent usage may save included quota without reducing cash spend; Token Factory usage may add incremental charges.
Empty request telemetry does not justify treating an outer Codex turn as one model request. Aggregate turn usage remains counted in full.
Cached Astra input is charged once at its cached-input rate; reasoning is already included in output. Token Factory uses full input rates without an assumed cache discount.
All screening attempts, rejected responses and operator recovery present in each included run are counted. Unknown failed-request usage prevents a complete total.
These totals exclude the supervising development/research conversation, prior experiments, CPU hosting, storage, network and human work; their actual invoice costs are not established.
One screened pair cannot establish a general causal performance advantage. Independent source/artifact acceptance and an unassisted confirmation are separate requirements.

Where completion telemetry contains an input-only setup response absent from CLI totals, its counters and possible additional tariff are reported separately; setup charging is unknown and base costs are explicitly CLI-recorded usage equivalents.
